pairingRule: pairs (a, b) with a before b in the systems order; label system-vs-reference when b is oracle, otherwise system-vs-system; differences are a minus b over the tracks where both have a value

statistics.accuracyRule: accuracy rates and paired accuracy differences count an abstention or failure as incorrect; coverage is reported beside them
statistics.directionRule: paired n >= 10, interval excludes zero, q < 0.05
statistics.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 of the resampled statistic of paired differences: the median for continuous metrics, the mean for yes/no metrics
statistics.multipleComparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values over all tests in a corpus
statistics.yesNoP: exact McNemar from the discordant counts

styleTags: OA300 and GiantSteps genre; 12.7 untagged; synthetic clicks by click shape

systems.boomboomboomkit-optimal: AudioAnalysisService.analyze(url:) at default options (TechniqueSet.optimal); grid = beat-grid tempo extrapolated from gridOrigin
systems.commercial-analyzer: a commercial DJ analyzer's BPM as recorded in the OA300 label file; version unrecorded, analysis mode unrecorded; no grid; OA300 only; a system under test, never the reference
systems.variant-comb-best-phase: Story 15.10 follow-up: the default grid re-anchored at the onset-comb best phase (internal BeatGridAnalyzer hook), observed on the default pass's decode; BPM answer unchanged from the default; refused per track when the observed run's output differs; runtime and memory not-comparable
systems.variant-fixed-time: Story 15.5 fixed-time model, BPM read from its scores files; tempo families only; Python inference, so runtime and memory are not-comparable with the Swift rows
systems.variant-joint-fit: Story 15.7: DSP stub observations -> bar-state decode at the default BPM and the quarter level (the level the BPM stage chose; the fit never changes octave) -> joint tempo and phase fit, on the default pass's decode; a nil decode or fit abstains; the metrical-level selector's choice is recorded per row as a diagnostic only
